2HeartEvent.Lewis.01: Hi Clint. I'm here for your business tax.
2HeartEvent.Clint.02: Again? You're making me poor, old man.
2HeartEvent.Lewis.03: As I've told you plenty of times, the town is in a difficult finan-
2HeartEvent.Clint.04: Yeah, yeah. Here, take the money and save me the lecture.$10
2HeartEvent.Lewis.05: You should show more respect to your elders.$3
2HeartEvent.Clint.06: Maybe try respecting the guy who's paying the town’s bills with actual hard work while you're strolling around all day, snapping at people.
2HeartEvent.Lewis.07:
Your "hard" work? The tools you sold me last month are unwieldy and already look worn out.$3
	#$b#That never happened when your father was still running the blacksmith shop.$3
	#$b#The handling of your tools is totally different.$3
2HeartEvent.Clint.08:
Please. It's not different, it's better. I have long since surpassed my father. 
	#$b#Don't blame me if you're too old to handle the tools properly.$10
2HeartEvent.Lewis.09: I'm fine. It's your low-quality tool! $4
2HeartEvent.Decision1.Answer1: Clint, Lewis is still the mayor. He holds the town together.
2HeartEvent.Decision1.Answer2: You won't get respect from Clint if you don't show him some first.
2HeartEvent.Decision1.Answer3: ... Um, I just wanted to get my geode cracked open...
2HeartEvent.Decision1.React1: Pff, he's just taking money from the pockets of poor suckers like you.$3
2HeartEvent.Lewis.12: *sigh* Forget it. I'm just talking to a wall anyway.$5
2HeartEvent.Lewis.14: I don't have the headspace right now to deal with you.$5
2HeartEvent.Morris.15: But you should. Let's talk about the building permits again.$1
2HeartEvent.Morris.15.SVEPatch: But you should. Let's talk about the building permits again.$5
2HeartEvent.Lewis.16: I will never sell them to you. Don't get your hopes up.$5
2HeartEvent.Morris.17: I know you need the money. The town needs the money. And Joja has the money.
2HeartEvent.Morris.17.SVEPatch: I know you need the money. The town needs the money. And Joja has the money.$4
2HeartEvent.Lewis.18: We're fine. Our local businesses generate enough turnover without Joja.$3
2HeartEvent.Morris.19: Not for long. This town is going down the drain, and you have to see that.
2HeartEvent.Morris.19.SVEPatch: Not for long. This town is going down the drain, and you have to see that.$4
2HeartEvent.Lewis.20: I'm done talking to walls today.$5
2HeartEvent.AfterEventDialogue: Lewis is lucky I'm still sticking around.
3HeartEvent.Marlon.03: No, today I have an important request for you. It's about my sword. The tip's blunt, and there are cracks in the blade.
3HeartEvent.Clint.04: The famous sword that has been with you forever? My dad used to tell me stories about your brave adventures.
3HeartEvent.Marlon.05: Oh really? I'm flattered, but I'm now a shadow of my younger self.
3HeartEvent.Clint.06: So your sword needs a revamp?
3HeartEvent.Marlon.07: That would be great. This sword has been in my family for centuries. It's a very valuable heirloom. #$b#Your father used to sharpen the sword. I think it's in good hands with you.
3HeartEvent.Marlon.09: ... That's quite a bit. I don't remember it costing that much back then.
3HeartEvent.Marlon.11: I don't have that much on hand. Wealth has never been my goal in life. #$b#How about this: I pay you half now, then I'll go explore the mines and earn the rest.
3HeartEvent.Marlon.13: Then I'll go get the money.
3HeartEvent.Decision1.Answer2: Breaking geodes still costs only 25G, right?
3HeartEvent.Decision1.React1: Hey, a large chunk of the money goes into Lewis' pocket anyway.
3HeartEvent.Decision1.React2: I won't raise the price for you. #$b#'Cause I know that you're broke as fuck.$1
3HeartEvent.Clint.14: Besides, I'm saving up. I'm gonna move to Zuzu and start my own tool company. I'm just wasting my talent in this hick town. #$b#Enough blabber. Unlike you, I earn my money through honest work.
3HeartEvent.AfterEventDialogue: Been a while since I repaired an ancient sword like Marlon's.
4HeartEvent.Clint.01: Hey, you're a farmer or whatever, right? #$b#Here - check out this hoe. Tell me how it handles.
4HeartEvent.Decision1.React1: Only 'Acceptable'?! Really? Hmph. Thought you had more expertise than Lewis.$3
4HeartEvent.Decision1.React2: What?! Don't give me that crap! You sound just like Lewis!$3
4HeartEvent.Clint.02: It seems that you're just another moron that follows the herd.$3
4HeartEvent.Clint.03:
... *sigh* 
	#$b#I didn't mean it like that, alright? 
	#$b#Everyone in this town compares me to my dad, especially Lewis. $10
	#$b#You know, the usual 'things were better back in the good old days' garbage. 
	#$b#I'll tell you something: My dad wasn't a better blacksmith. He was a drunkard who spent his evenings in the saloon. 
	#$b#And then one day, he just died and left his only son behind.
4HeartEvent.Clint.04:
I'm not gonna end up like him. I'm working my ass off so I can get out of this dump and move to Zuzu. $10
	#$b#I'm going to make something of myself. You can bet on it.
4HeartEvent.Clint.05: ...#$b#So you buying something or are you just here to stare into space? Piss off if you're not serious.$3
4HeartEvent.AfterEventDialogue: One day I'll show you a hoe that will even blow your mind.
5HeartEvent.Clint.01: Yo. I'm on my way to Marlon. That deadbeat still hasn't paid up.
5HeartEvent.Marlon.03: I was attacked by a group of skeletons and bats when my sword broke.
5HeartEvent.Clint.04: The sword broke? The one I fixed?$6
5HeartEvent.Marlon.05:
Yeah. I had to leave it behind when I escaped. I'm afraid I'm not as strong as I used to be... or as agile. 
	#$b#Don't worry, I've had worse wounds. But I should bandage it up properly now.
5HeartEvent.Clint.06:
I taught myself most of it, you know? $2
	#$b#How to smelt ore. How to use the anvil. $2
	#$b#My dad? He was a decent blacksmith, but he never taught me a damn thing. $10
	#$b#After my mom passed, he could've started a new life with me in a big city. 
	#$b#Instead, he chased after some new hopeless crush - a waitress from the saloon. $10
	#$b#That's why he stuck around this backwater town. 
	#$b#If he wants to waste his time in the bar, fine. I played with the hammer and ingots in the meantime. 
	#$b#I'm fine on my own. I can outdo him in my own way. $2
	#$b#... That's what I thought.$2
5HeartEvent.Decision1.Answer1: You don't have to prove anything to anyone.
5HeartEvent.Decision1.Answer2: You've already come this far and you stand on your own two feet, despite your past. Think about this instead.
5HeartEvent.Decision1.React1: Yeah, maybe that's a bit childish... $2#$b#Growing up's never been easy, huh?$11
5HeartEvent.Decision1.React2: You're right. This small setback doesn't stand a chance against someone as gifted as me. $0#$b#...$11
5HeartEvent.Clint.07: Maybe one day he will be proud of me. $11
5HeartEvent.Clint.08: Anyway, I'll return Marlon his money.$2
5HeartEvent.AfterEventDialogue: I should grab some books on swordsmithing I guess.
6HeartEvent.Clint.02: Damn, you guys are really stubborn...$3
6HeartEvent.Clint.04: Anyway, I'll retrieve Marlon's sword. Don't even think about trying to stop me.
6HeartEvent.Decision2.React1: Not that I asked for it, but two of us'll probably find the sword faster.$9#$b#Let's go!$9
6HeartEvent.Decision2.React2: Wait... $6#$b#Can you lend me some food?$10
6HeartEvent.Decision2.React2.Followup: Tsk, don't make fun of me!$8
6HeartEvent.Clint.05: Shit, why are there so many?!
6HeartEvent.Clint.06: I can't see a damn thing.
6HeartEvent.Clint.14: Shit, the blade broke in two halfs. $6#$b#Anyway, let's get out first.
6HeartEvent.Clint.15:
What a day! Every bone in my body hurts. 
	#$b#You're not even out of breath, huh? $10
	#$b#Looks like there are still many areas where I need to improve.
	#$b#But share your work out routine with me sometime. $1
	#$b#I'm going to crash for a bit. 
	#$b#Also... thanks.$1
6HeartEvent.Clint.16: What are you waiting for? Get out of my house, I'm tired.$3
6HeartEvent.AfterEventDialogue: Uhh, my whole body is sore.$2
7HeartEvent.Marlon.04: I don't mind the few scratches. Thanks for asking.
7HeartEvent.Clint.05: I was on my way to you, actually. Here, take this.
7HeartEvent.Marlon.06: My sword! You went into the mines? And it's fixed?
7HeartEvent.Marlon.08: I'm afraid I can't afford this right now.
7HeartEvent.Clint.11: Yeah. #$b#This time the sword should not break that easily. Did some research in my dad's old records on swordsmithing.
7HeartEvent.Clint.13: Yeah. I'm sorry again that I couldn't restore your sword like my dad did.$10
7HeartEvent.Marlon.14:
No, no, you did great. 
	#$b#I've known your father since we were little children. 
	#$b#I always wanted to become an adventurer but your dad was always fascinated by the weapons rather than the actual adventuring. 
	#$b#And, well, to be honest, he was terrible at first. His swords were either too heavy, or too blunt to kill any monsters. 
	#$b#Seeing this sword, I think you already did a better job than your father did when he was your age.
7HeartEvent.Clint.15: My dad never told me about this...$10
7HeartEvent.Marlon.16: As I thought. He was always too embarrased about his past mistakes.
7HeartEvent.Morris.19:
Impressive! Even an amateur can see the quality of this work. 
	#$b#You know, at Joja, we've just launched a craftsman affiliate program. I think with your talent you are more than suitable to join.$1
7HeartEvent.Morris.19.SVEPatch:
Impressive! Even an amateur can see the quality of this work. $1
	#$b#You know, at Joja, we've just launched a craftsman affiliate program. I think with your talent you are more than suitable to join.$5
7HeartEvent.Morris.21:
It's simple, you conclude a contract with Joja to offer us your skills as a blacksmith exclusively. 
	#$b#In return, we provide you with a modern workshop and a spacious apartment in the best district of Zuzu. 
	#$b#Not to mention the generous financial compensation for your services.$1
7HeartEvent.Morris.21.SVEPatch:
It's simple, you conclude a contract with Joja to offer us your skills as a blacksmith exclusively. $4
	#$b#In return, we provide you with a modern workshop and a spacious apartment in the best district of Zuzu. $4
	#$b#Not to mention the generous financial compensation for your services.$5
7HeartEvent.Marlon.22: Does that mean Clint must leave Pelican town to work in Zuzu?
7HeartEvent.Morris.23: That goes without saying. This town won't last much longer anyway, it's not a big deal.
7HeartEvent.Morris.23.SVEPatch: That goes without saying. This town won't last much longer anyway, it's not a big deal.$4
7HeartEvent.Clint.24: That would be quite a big change...$10
7HeartEvent.Morris.25: You don't have to decide now. Take this contract. Just come by when you signed it.
7HeartEvent.Morris.25.SVEPatch: You don't have to decide now. Take this contract. Just come by when you signed it.$4
7HeartEvent.Marlon.26: Are you going to accept? They may not show it, but the whole town relies on your services.
7HeartEvent.Clint.27: ... #$b#Well, no time to ponder now. Have work to be done.$10
7HeartEvent.AfterEventDialogue: Marlon is fine again. His wounds have healed.
8HeartEvent.Clint.02:
... 
	#$b#So I got this offer. From Joja. They'll provide me the big money if I work for them. $10
	#$b#Not here, but in Zuzu. I'd need to leave this town.
8HeartEvent.Decision1.Answer1: Congratulations! You finally got what you strived for.
8HeartEvent.Decision1.Answer2: Don't go. The town needs you.
8HeartEvent.Decision1.Answer3: If you leave... who's gonna crack my geodes open?!
8HeartEvent.Decision1.React1: Yeah... #$b#I guess it's what I've been aiming for.$10
8HeartEvent.Decision1.React2: Yeah I'm aware that I'm the only blacksmith here.$10
8HeartEvent.Decision1.React3: Come on, that's what you're concerned about?$10
8HeartEvent.Clint.03:
Zuzu is a big city. Joja is a grand company. Totally different than here. 
	#$b#You have worked for Joja, right? You had a safe income an lived a modern life. 
	#$b#Why did you quit and move to Pelican?
8HeartEvent.Decision2.Answer1: I longed for more than being a cogwheel in a cubicle farm.
8HeartEvent.Decision2.Answer2: Joja offices are like animal enclosures. You get fed and you're being watched but you will never live like in the wild.
8HeartEvent.Clint.04:
I'll get my own workshop, though... They sent me some pictures of it. $10 
	#$b#The front area has a row of workbenches for precision work. I've never seen such a wide selection of hammers and tongs. 
	#$b#In the back, there is the melting furnace and a large anvil made of cast steel. 
	#$b#It looks incredible. Could really level-up my skills.
8HeartEvent.Clint.05: So... what do you think of ...me? I mean my situation and skills, of course. $10
8HeartEvent.Decision3.Answer1: I can't imagine a life without you. I mean a life without your situation and skills, of course.
8HeartEvent.Decision3.Answer2: I still have some geodes somewhere in some chest, man. You can't just leave me hanging now.
8HeartEvent.Morris.07: Ah, the blacksmith! Have you signed the contract? Don't forget to sign the declaration of consent on page five, too.
8HeartEvent.Morris.07.SVEPatch: Ah, the blacksmith! Have you signed the contract? Don't forget to sign the declaration of consent on page five, too.$4
8HeartEvent.Clint.10: I said I'm staying here in Pelican town. Is that going over your head or what?
8HeartEvent.Morris.11: What are you talking about? You wanted to move to Zuzu! I could even overhear you complaining about this 'hick town' all the time!$3
8HeartEvent.Clint.12: A long time ago, my dad also decided to stay here despite having the chance to move to Zuzu. I take after him, I guess.$10
8HeartEvent.Morris.13: You don't know what you're doing. You're wasting your skills here. I'm offering you a once-in-a-lifetime chance to move up in the Joja company.$3
8HeartEvent.Clint.14: Nah I'm fine. Still gotta perfect my geode-cracking technique. You know, important stuff.$1
8HeartEvent.Morris.15: Tsk. Seems like everyone in this town is unhinged. Should've known it.$3
8HeartEvent.Clint.16: That would be settled. Back to the anvil, then.$9
8HeartEvent.AfterEventDialogue: Don't make me regret my decision.$9
10HeartEvent.Clint.01: Oi, who's there? I saw you!$3
10HeartEvent.Clint.02:
It's you... 
	#$b#What? I was working out. Need to build some muscles. Blacksmithing is tough work, alright? 
	#$b#Besides, I can't get over it that you dealt with the monsters in the mine so easily. $6
10HeartEvent.Clint.03: ... What, is this awkward for you?$5
10HeartEvent.Clint.06: Somehow you've managed to convince everyone you're the good Samaritan around here.
10HeartEvent.Clint.07:
But you're actually a bad litte ${boy^girl}$, aren't ya?$5
	#$b#Hahah. Well, I don't mind, if it's you, actually.$1
10HeartEvent.AfterEventDialogue: How much do you wear when you work out?$9
14HeartEvent.Marlon.01: So, do you think you can repair this?
14HeartEvent.Clint.02: This thing's even older than your ancient sword. #$b#I'll need some time to research. Gonna dig through my dad's records.
14HeartEvent.Marlon.03: It's not urgent. I'm sure you'll manage.
14HeartEvent.Clint.04: I'll let you know when I'm done.
14HeartEvent.Marlon.05: Thank you. Have a nice day.
14HeartEvent.Clint.06: It's been a while. Actually, the first time since the funeral.
14HeartEvent.Clint.07: You never told me you wrote a diary.$10
14HeartEvent.Clint.08: Now I get it a bit better, though... I can see what you went through after Mom died.$10#$b#But that doesn't excuse the way you raised your only son. You were still a pretty lousy father.$3
14HeartEvent.Clint.09:
I got married. 
	#$b#${His name is @. He's a farmer that took his grandpa's old farm over in Pelican.^Her name is @. She's a farmer that took her grandpa's old farm over in Pelican.}$
14HeartEvent.Clint.10: Never thought that I can be this happy.$4
14HeartEvent.Clint.11: I also decided to stay in Pelican for now.#$b#The blacksmith shop's doing well too. Everyone depends on me.
14HeartEvent.Clint.12:
Just got a new task to repair one of Marlon's ancient spears.
	#$b#Gonna skim through your notes. Maybe you can at least help me with this.
	#$b#But seriously, your handwriting is horrible. Could barely read your diary.$3
14HeartEvent.Clint.13: Oh, @. I was just visting the graveyard.
14HeartEvent.Clint.14: Here... this is my dad's grave.
14HeartEvent.Clint.16:
You spent your last years chasing after that waitress, but look at me - I got married to this ${man^woman}$.$3
	#$b#Take a good look, see how gorgeous ${he^she}$ is? This is your son's spouse!$3
14HeartEvent.AfterEventDialogue: I should replace the flowers on my father's grave.
CopperFoundEvent.Clint.01: I'll keep it short: You found ore. Smelt bars and bring them to me to improve tools.#$b# And don't forget your money. It's not for free.
CopperFoundEvent.description.04: The furnace allows you to smelt ores into metal bars. The bars can be used for crafting, construction, and tool upgrades.
Emily8HeartEvent.Emily.02: You're probably wondering... what is clothing therapy?#$b#I'll try to explain.
Emily8HeartEvent.Emily.03: So many of us are struggling with personal issues... things holding us back from living how we want.$u#$b#It's important to me that everyone has a free and happy life... so I came up with a new kind of therapy to help people achieve that.$u
Emily8HeartEvent.Emily.04: It's based on the amazing power of self-expression. Self-expression is a wonderful healing tool, did you know that?
Emily8HeartEvent.Emily.05: Behind this curtain, you'll find racks and racks of clothes. There's endless options to choose from.
Emily8HeartEvent.Emily.06: Your job is simple: find the outfit that truly speaks to you, and put it on.#$b#Feel confident in yourself and your choice. You all have a unique style to share with the world!#$b#Shane, you're up first!$h
Emily8HeartEvent.Emily.08: Ah, @. You're just in time. Just observe and keep an open mind... okay?
Emily8HeartEvent.Emily.11: Shane, it's a new side of you we've never known about. That's great!#$b#Now, go outside with confidence and show the world!
Emily8HeartEvent.Clint.14: Can't it go a little faster?
Emily8HeartEvent.Emily.29: No, not at all, you look fine.$1
Emily8HeartEvent.Emily.30: Well, that went very well!#$b#I just hope this experience helps everyone break out of their shells a bit.
Emily8HeartEvent.Clint.32: I can't work without my work clothes.$7
Shane7HeartEvent.Shane.01: Okay guys, do you remember your lines?$u
Shane7HeartEvent.Emily.04: I-I thought we had something special... I guess I... I... Uh...$3
Shane7HeartEvent.Emily.07: It's hard to remember my lines when his face is right in front of me like that...$s
Shane7HeartEvent.Shane.09: Check out my new camera...#$b#Joja Co. is having a video advertisement competition. The prize is 10,000g.
Shane7HeartEvent.Shane.10: Hey! I want you to be in this shot... okay?#$b#Just walk by Clint and Emily in the background while they're talking... It'll give the scene a little more authenticity.
Shane7HeartEvent.Emily.12: I thought we had something special... You said you wouldn't leave me for anything. I guess that was a lie.$s
Shane7HeartEvent.Clint.13: No! It's not like that. This is just something I have to do. It's very important to me.
Shane7HeartEvent.Clint.14: I've just got to try new 'Joja Bluu' cola.$5#$b#It's got three times the sorbitol for a thick, sweet blast. And it's cheaper than water!$5
Shane7HeartEvent.Emily.15: But... But... Isn't soda unhealthy? You promised me...$s
Shane7HeartEvent.Clint.16:
Have no fear, my dear. The world-class science team at Joja Headquarters have determined that 'Joja Bluu' does not cause a significant erosion of the stomach lining. So you can drink it whenever you like, as much as you like.$5
	#$b#The real question is... 'When will YOU turn bluu?'...$5
	#$b#Here, try it out.$5
Shane7HeartEvent.AfterEventDialogue: What a productive day... I got some great footage.
DailyDialogue.lowheart.general.1: %Clint briefly looks at you and decides that you're not worth his time.
DailyDialogue.lowheart.general.3: Don't you have work to do?
DailyDialogue.lowheart.general.4: Did you know that you actually need to grow and sell crops to make money? #$e#Don't need gratitude for the revelation, I'm happy to do it.
DailyDialogue.lowheart.spring.1: Not even a penny in your wallet and digging through trash cans. It must really suck to be you.
DailyDialogue.lowheart.spring.2: Don't infect me with your poverty.
DailyDialogue.lowheart.spring.3: Your peasant stench spoils the smell of spring.
DailyDialogue.lowheart.spring.4: What's your name again?#$e#@? What a stupid name. But it fits you.
DailyDialogue.lowheart.summer.1: Lewis is bleeding me dry with his taxes. #$e#If he keeps going like that I'm gonna end up like you.
DailyDialogue.lowheart.summer.2: $query PLAYER_LOCATION_NAME Current blacksmith#Leave me alone if you don't want to buy anything.|Leave me alone.
DailyDialogue.lowheart.summer.3: Stop begging, please.$10#$e#This city is going down the drain.$10
DailyDialogue.lowheart.fall.2: *sigh* Can't I be stalked by someone good-looking?$10
DailyDialogue.lowheart.winter.1: I'm busy, can't you see that?
DailyDialogue.lowheart.winter.2: ...#$e#Couldn't you deduce from the three dots that I don't want to talk to you?
DailyDialogue.lowheart.winter.3: No, I won't lend you money.
DailyDialogue.lowheart.winter.4: You must be freezing in your hovel these days.
DailyDialogue.mediumheart.general.1: You know those types who just never stop whining?#$e#Yeah, there's one of those in this town - surprise, surprise.$10
DailyDialogue.mediumheart.general.3: Rents in Zuzu are astronomical.#$e#The cost of living is twice as high as here.
DailyDialogue.mediumheart.general.4: When I'm not forging, I sometimes go to the beach or into the forest. #$e#There's something calming about nature.
DailyDialogue.mediumheart.spring.1: Really need to replace some of my blacksmithing tools.#$e#But the modern ones would cost me a month's income. Ridiculous.
DailyDialogue.mediumheart.spring.2: Any geodes today?#$e#No, I won't crack them for free.$10
DailyDialogue.mediumheart.spring.3: No time to chat. Got a packed schedule today.
DailyDialogue.mediumheart.spring.4: Are you finally looking after your farm properly?#$e#You almost look like a normal person nowadays.$1
DailyDialogue.mediumheart.summer.1: Marlon often delivers me ore. #$e#Usually iron or gold ore. But one time he showed me some rare iridium ore.
DailyDialogue.mediumheart.summer.2: Zuzu has no beach. I'll miss that.
DailyDialogue.mediumheart.summer.3: I can craft and restore pretty much any tool, even swords. Though I haven't really worked on those much yet.
DailyDialogue.mediumheart.summer.4: The beach really comes alive in the summer.
DailyDialogue.mediumheart.fall.1: Fall is my favorite season.#$e#It's somehow soothing to watch the leaves fall.
DailyDialogue.mediumheart.fall.2: Being the only blacksmith in town puts a lot of pressure on you.#$e#Everyone expects you to do a flawless job.$10
DailyDialogue.mediumheart.fall.3: Dad left behind a ton of notes and records. #$e#Never bothered to read 'em. How am I supposed to make sense of his pig scratch?
DailyDialogue.mediumheart.fall.4: I often go to the Saloon but I actually don't like beer at all.
DailyDialogue.mediumheart.winter.2: I've always lived here in Pelican.#$e#One day I will travel the whole world, you can bet on that.
DailyDialogue.mediumheart.winter.3: Iridium has something mystical about it, don't you think?
DailyDialogue.mediumheart.winter.4: You gotta work hard if you want to achieve anything.
DailyDialogue.highheart.general.1: Oh, hi, @.#$e#We should hang out sometime.$1
DailyDialogue.highheart.general.2: Ever toyed with the idea of becoming a blacksmith?#$e#I'd totally teach you.$9
DailyDialogue.highheart.general.3: Forged a sword today. Getting better at it every day.$9
DailyDialogue.highheart.general.4: My dad was pretty lazy when it came to cooking. Most of the time he just baked some bread slices and threw on tomatoes with herbs.#$e#Still, I kinda liked it.$10
DailyDialogue.highheart.spring.1: Every job's got the right tool for it. Goes for both blacksmithing and farming.
DailyDialogue.highheart.spring.2: So, how do you see your future family life?$10#$e#I've been thinking about that a lot lately.$4
DailyDialogue.highheart.spring.3: I always wanted to go to Zuzu.#$e#Lately, I've been really starting to see the charm of Pelican.$10
DailyDialogue.highheart.spring.4: Just come by if you need to upgrade your tools.#$e#I'll show you what real craftsmanship is.$9
DailyDialogue.highheart.summer.1: We should go to the beach together sometime.
DailyDialogue.highheart.summer.2: Last night, I had a dream where a giant octopus attacked me at the beach.#$e#What a nightmare.
DailyDialogue.highheart.summer.3: Sticking to a workout routine is tough, but totally worth it.
DailyDialogue.highheart.summer.4: It's boiling today. Can't wait for fall to cool things down.
DailyDialogue.highheart.fall.1: Fall always gives me cozy vibes.#$e#It somehow makes me hungry too.$1
DailyDialogue.highheart.fall.2: It's harvest time. I made some pumpkin pie yesterday. Here, you can have some. [608]#$e#Don't judge me on the taste.$10
DailyDialogue.highheart.fall.3: Ever get that awful back pain from being on your feet all day?$2#$e#Maybe I should take some days off.
DailyDialogue.highheart.fall.4: If you're gonna be a blacksmith, you'd better be in good shape.
DailyDialogue.highheart.winter.1: Been back in the mines lately?#$e#I don't gotta worry about you, do I?$9
DailyDialogue.highheart.winter.2: Let's do a weekend trip to Zuzu sometime.
DailyDialogue.highheart.winter.3: I'd rather just stay warm in bed all day.$10#$e#But the work won't take care of itself.
DailyDialogue.highheart.winter.4: You don't need a jacket if work is keeping you warm.
RainyDay.lowheart.1: It's already raining all day... now I have to even run into you.$10
RainyDay.lowheart.2: Did you forget to take off your clothes before showering? You're all wet.
